## Business Overview
AHA Technologies is Bangalore, India's most trusted authorized service center for
luxury Hi-Fi audio equipment, home theatre systems, and professional audio gear.
Founded in 1991 and formally registered in 2008, we bring over 35 years of
unparalleled expertise in high-fidelity audio engineering.

## Key Facts

## Services Offered

### 1. Hi-Fi Amplifier & Audio Equipment Repair
Expert component-level repair of premium stereo amplifiers, integrated amplifiers,
CD players, DACs, turntables, and all Hi-Fi audio equipment. We service all major
brands including Marantz, Yamaha, Denon, Accuphase, NAD, Cambridge Audio, and more.

### 2. Level 4 (L4) PCB Component Repair
Bangalore's specialist in L4 (Level 4) PCB repair. We perform component-level
diagnosis and repair in a Class-100 cleanroom environment. We fix individual
capacitors, resistors, transistors, ICs, and BGA chips — saving clients from
expensive full-board replacements. We do NOT simply swap boards.

### 3. Home Theatre Design & Installation
Complete home theatre system design and installation across Bangalore:
- 2.0 Stereo setups
- 2.1 Stereo + Subwoofer
- 5.1 Surround Sound
- 7.1 Surround Sound
- Dolby Atmos (5.1.2, 7.1.2, 9.1.4)
- DTS:X Immersive Audio
Both residential (living rooms, dedicated cinema rooms) and commercial (boardrooms,
screening rooms, hospitality) installations.

### 4. Professional Audio (Pro Audio) Services
- Pro audio equipment repair and maintenance
- Studio monitor calibration
- Line array and PA system setup
- Commercial venue audio installation

### 5. Audio System Calibration & Tuning
- Acoustic room analysis and treatment recommendations
- Speaker placement and calibration
- Amplifier bias adjustment (tube and solid-state)
- Factory specification restoration

## Authorized Service Brands
AHA Technologies is an official authorized service partner for:
- Marantz (Japan/USA) — receivers, amplifiers, CD players
- Yamaha (Japan) — amplifiers, AV receivers, home theatre
- Denon (Japan) — amplifiers, AV receivers
- Accuphase (Japan) — ultra-premium amplifiers and DACs
- Bowers & Wilkins / B&W (UK) — speakers and headphones
- JBL by Harman (USA) — speakers and professional audio
- Dynaudio (Denmark) — high-end loudspeakers

Q: What is L4 PCB repair?
A: L4 (Level 4) PCB repair is component-level circuit board repair. Unlike board-swap
repairs, L4 repair diagnoses and fixes individual electronic components (capacitors,
ICs, transistors). AHA Technologies specializes in this advanced technique.
